thingsToDo.title: Visit Newport Beach Pier
thingsToDo.description: Newport Beach Pier is a waterfront in Newport Beach, California. Newport Beach Pier is a classic Southern California pier with wide ocean views and a relaxed, beach-town vibe. The wooden span is great for sunrise walks and casual fishing, while the nearby sand offers plenty of space for lounging. It is a signature stop that anchors the city’s coastal scene.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Balboa Pier
thingsToDo.description: Balboa Pier is a waterfront in Newport Beach, California. Balboa Pier sits on the Balboa Peninsula with a compact boardwalk, waterfront cafés, and easy access to the sand. It is a low-key alternative to the main pier, ideal for a short stroll or a sunset photo stop. Pair it with a nearby bike ride along the shoreline path.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Balboa Island Ferry
thingsToDo.description: Balboa Island Ferry is a waterfront in Newport Beach, California. The Balboa Island Ferry is a quick, scenic hop across Newport Harbor that locals use to move between the peninsula and Balboa Island. The short ride offers views of sailboats, waterfront homes, and the harbor’s calm channels. It is a charming, low-effort way to experience the waterfront without a long tour.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Crystal Cove State Park
thingsToDo.description: Crystal Cove State Park is a park in Newport Beach, California. Crystal Cove State Park protects a stretch of coastal cliffs and sandy coves just south of Newport Beach. The trails above the beach deliver sweeping ocean views, while the historic cottages add character to the shoreline. It is a strong pick for an easy coastal hike that still feels scenic and wild.
